mustResolveBeforeSubmission: FreeIPAPI production IP disclosure, regional egress, vendor processing/retention and account-recovery exceptions against the commissioned deployment
Actual regional processors, countries, retention, incident/access logs and contract terms
Apple and Google categories for every collected field, including identifiers and guardian-document contents
Optional collection and Google sharing/service-provider exceptions against actual deployed behavior
All native SDK privacy manifests, required-reason APIs, permissions and signed binary contents
In-transit protection for every actual service endpoint, deletion paths and backup/custody expiry
Final audience, age-rating, Families/COPPA and regional child-consent/classification decisions
A real support response process and stable public privacy/account-deletion URLs
No data-is-not-collected or no-data-shared blanket claim based on local tests alone
